translated_content: After today's emergency meeting of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina Government, held in Mostar, Prime Minister Fadil Novalić unveiled a comprehensive plan to revitalize the Government's operations. The Prime Minister also underscored that the Government's priorities would focus on addressing pressing issues, including debt repayment to Russia, gas protection, support for farmers, and youth empowerment. article_content: Većina aviona je obojena u bijelu boju, ali malo ljudi zna zašto. Naime, postoje neki vrlo važni razlozi za ovu odluku. Prema informacijama Međunarodne asocijacije za zračni transport (IATA), tokom prošle godine je obavljeno čak 4,5 milijardi letova. Ove brojke pokazuju da je broj letova udvostručen u odnosu na period prije 15 godina te da iznosi polovinu od svjetske populacije. Kako bi ispunili rastuću potražnju, proizvođači aviona su napravili veće letjelice poput dvospratnog Airbusa A380 i Boeinga 787 Dreamliner, što omogućava efikasnije korištenje kapaciteta i smanjenje troška. Bijela boja aviona nije samo estetski izbor, već i praktičan. Ona reflektuje sunčevu svjetlost i gotovo svu svjetlost koja pada na njega, dok druge boje absorbuju određenu količinu svjetlosti. Također, bijela boja je korisna za uočavanje pukotina i udubljenja, kao i za vizuelno uočavanje aviona u slučaju nesreća. Osim toga, bijela boja aviona olakšava održavanje i popravak, jer se lakše uočavaju eventualne štete ili nepravilnosti.
translated_content: Most airplanes are painted white, but few people are aware of the reasons behind this decision. According to the International Air Transport Association (IATA), a record 4.5 billion flights took place last year. This represents a doubling of flights over the past 15 years, with the number of passengers now accounting for half of the global population. To cater to the increasing demand, aircraft manufacturers have developed larger planes, such as the double-decker Airbus A380 and Boeing 787 Dreamliner. These larger aircraft enable more efficient use of capacity, resulting in lower costs. The white color of the aircraft serves both aesthetic and practical purposes. It reflects sunlight and virtually all the light that hits it, whereas other colors absorb a certain amount of light. The white color also makes it easier to detect any cracks, dents, or other damage, and improves visibility in the event of an accident. Moreover, the white color facilitates maintenance and repair work, as any potential issues can be easily identified.

Ove godine na „Danima teatra mladih“ publici je predstavljeno sedam predstava koje su premijerno izvedene u protekloj sezoni ili su doživjele brojna izvođenja, a sve su bile veliki uspjesi. Završetak je to redovnog igranja predstava Mostarskog teatra mladih na matičnoj sceni, ali će se predstave igrati na festivalima i brojnim drugim ljetnim susretima, kao i u okviru turističke ponude, što će dodatno potaknuti razvoj kulture u Mostaru. Već tradicionalno na kraju Dana teatra mladih dodjeljuje se eMTeeM-ova maska najuspješnijoj predstavi, a u netom završenoj sezoni to su bile predstave „Nijemi krik“ i „Mir“, koje su osvojile srca publike. Izaslanstvo eMTeeM-a i Centra za dramski odgoj sutra putuje u Zagreb, gdje će u okviru simpozija „Budućnost dramskog odgoja“, u organizaciji Učiteljskog fakulteta Sveučilišta u Zagrebu, imati uvodni referat o svom radu te radionicu o metodologiji koju primjenjuje na radionicama pomirenja, što će doprinijeti razvoju umjetnosti u regiji. Nakon Zagreba, ansambl predstave „Mir“ putuje u Postojnu, Republika Slovenija, gdje će nastupiti na 7. FAK festivalu, što će biti veliki uspjeh za Mostarski teatar mladih.
translated_content: The play „Mir“ concluded the 31st „Youth Theater Days“ last night, which was organized by the Mostar Youth Theater 1974 (eMTeeM 1974) and achieved great success. This year, the audience at the „Youth Theater Days“ was presented with seven plays that premiered in the previous season or had multiple performances, all of which were highly successful. The regular performance of the Mostar Youth Theater on its home stage has come to an end, but the plays will be performed at festivals and numerous other summer events, as well as part of the tourist offer, further promoting the development of culture in Mostar. Traditionally, at the end of the Youth Theater Days, the eMTeeM award is given to the most successful play, and in the recently completed season, the plays „Nijemi krik“ and „Mir“ received this award, winning over the audience's hearts. The eMTeeM and Center for Dramatic Education delegation will travel to Zagreb tomorrow, where they will deliver a keynote speech on their work and conduct a workshop on the methodology applied to reconciliation workshops, contributing to the development of art in the region. Following Zagreb, the „Mir“ play ensemble will travel to Postojna, Slovenia, to perform at the 7th FAK festival, marking a significant success for the Mostar Youth Theater.
